entries.060523dd312a36cd: It has set out a medium- to long-term vision of 'becoming a growing company that supports a sustainable society with specialty products and services' (2034 fiscal year goal), and positions the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2027', running from April 2025 to March 2028, as a period for proactive capital investment and restructuring of its business structure. In the domestic food business, it will develop and foster market-creating products, strengthen proposals for the takeaway and ready-to-eat market, and advance proposals that lead to reduced food loss. In the domestic chemical products and other business, it will concentrate on deepening its domestic market in its areas of strength and make proposals to Japanese companies expanding overseas. In the overseas business, it will prioritize investment in its core plant, the Malaysian subsidiary, and reorganize production lines in China, making upfront investments to build a new structure. It also aims to shift toward management that is conscious of the balance sheet and to reduce policy-held shares.
